column1: # Runtime probes of the Xlin Kernel and the kernel configuration options each one depends on.
#   id    kind    arg    expected    required-options    description
# id        group.name; the group (hardening, systemd) selects the guest suite that runs it.
# kind      sysctl (file holds expected) | exists (path exists) | contains (file contains expected text)
#           | lsm (name is in /sys/kernel/security/lsm) | dmesg (ERE matches the kernel log)
#           | config (value of CONFIG_<arg> in /proc/config.gz, NOT a behavioural test)
#           | cmd (shell command exits 0) | special (function special_<arg> in tests/runtime/probes.sh)
# required-options  comma list SYMBOL=value that must hold in the final kernel config for the probe
#                   to be meaningful. scripts/xlin-probe-map checks this against the real .config and
#                   reports probes whose option is absent as UNSUPPORTED, instead of hiding them.
